The hunt for gold is never easy, and every decision can make or break a mining season. From tough calls on the claims to equipment troubles and the pressure to bring in more gold, the miners face one challenge after another as they fight to make their efforts pay off. With high stakes and fortunes on the line, every discovery matters. Will their hard work lead to a major payoff, or will the challenges get the better of them?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 9, 16, 7, 1, 15, 8 and 5, on Discovery Channel India.
